full_context_review.scope: Complete actual H2 5 and9 prose and source-unit spans; no fixed section5 paragraph minimum or language-length heuristic. Cross-section applicability/meaning is independently reviewed separately.

actual_stored_projection_bodies.scope: All12 protocol fields, complete calculation/input/output, quality requirements/evidence, all measurement/property/unit bodies, source records, full row descriptions/amount evidence/basis/ranges, boundary/allocation/validation and reference fields. Literal and complete source/ancestor context checks are separate.

measurementRules.rule: Q is the sum of measured net kg of each complete configured cabin first quality-released once in the cohort. Weigh on a calibrated scale or reconcile calibrated masses of the complete actual configuration; subtract only measured excluded transport/temporary items. Catalogue approximate weights are not Q.

Keep raw V in its original units; convert genuine rates by time integration and unit conversions before physical reconciliation and burden attribution. Already integrated volumes are not multiplied by time again. normalize_once produces the sole per-reference result. Collection retains raw quantities, never a pre-divided result.

A selected flow retains its full native restrictions and reference-property version to unit-group version and reference-unit chain. Number of items Item(s) and item differ only by spelling (factor 1); no item-to-kg, area-to-mass or density inference. Any needed conversion requires independent measured same-configuration net mass or actual geometry/material-specific density and state.

Retain native solid-volume units for actual sawn timber and P5 particleboard. Measure supplied/used net solid geometry and moisture by lot; independently weigh wet mass for physical closure. Density conversion is allowed only from independent same-material measurement at the actual state, never a catalogue or secondary property factor.

Separate supplied full formulations/articles from their non-additive assays; distinguish retained/free/liquid/vapour/structural/reaction water only with evidence. Electricity kWh times 3.6 gives MJ. Actual carrier water/condensate/hot-water returns need gross mass, phase, T/P, enthalpy and supplier water/energy ownership; one supply is not purchased again as both kg and heat MJ. No steam/boiler loop is assumed.

calculationRules.rule: For each physical exchange set B_e to its full gross actual V_e in the native unit after recorded unit/state conversion; for a burden exchange set B_e to its dedicated/causally attributed A_e. r_e = B_e / Q exactly once for manufacturing, or B_e / original Qc for separately declared post-release service. Q and Qc are kg of the same complete configuration. If the relevant denominator is zero retain B_e without a unit result. Cards and protocol target bases reference this one result, never a second division.

Preserve original meter, weighing and state fields. Integrate a genuine rate over the recorded interval once; retain already integrated volume unchanged. Use independently measured substance-specific density/state for any volume/mass bridge and the exact native property/unit support for any unit conversion. Then reconcile physical balances and attribute A_e before normalize_once. No inferred density, part mass or carrier enthalpy.

Maintain each material physical opening+external receipts=closing+external outputs+evidenced transformation, with internal handoffs cancelled once and reaction/element checks independent. Carry each inherited exchange vector with WIP and FG by its real cohort. At first release transfer Q internally to FG; it is already in production Q even if retained at close. In FG trace original delivery/reversal, returns and actual incremental services against original Qc; do not recreate manufacture.

O + P + I + ER + J_in + H2O_in = C + S + EO + W + J_out + H2O_out. All terms are actual kg for one material/asset pool. O/C are complete wet opening/closing empty, attached WIP, attached FG and reusable stocks. P is new external procurement, I is disjoint supplier-included whole packaging ingress, ER external return received, S full gross shipment-attached export, EO independent external return sent, W whole wet discard. J_in/J_out are independently measured non-water repair/replacement/deposit/residue or other pool transfers not already in those whole legs. H2O_in/H2O_out are independently measured actual water transfers not already embodied in whole legs, including natural adsorption/desorption without repair. Split real wet added/removed materials into disjoint J and water from actual measurements, with no default ratio/density. Full W contains substrate, retained residues and water once; its nested children are not extra J_out/H2O_out unless actually separated before crossing. Matched internal pool transfers cancel without new purchase, service or Q.

measurementRules.rule: Q为本队列每座指定完整舱体首次质量放行一次的实测净千克之和。用经校准秤称量或核对完整真实配置的经校准分项质量；只减实测排除的运输及临时物。目录近似重量不是Q。
raw V保留原单位；真实速率先按时间积分并换算单位，再做物理核对和负荷归属。已积分体积不再乘时间。normalize_once产生唯一每参考流结果。采集保留raw量，不采预先相除结果。
所选流保留完整原生限制及精确参考属性版本、单位组版本和参考单位链。Number of items的Item(s)与item仅拼写不同，因子1；不推定件转千克、面积转质量或密度。必要换算须有独立实测同配置净质量或真实几何、物质专属密度及状态。
真实锯材及P5刨花板保留原生实体积单位。逐批测供货领用净实体几何及含水；物理闭合另独立称湿质量。密度换算仅可依据真实状态同材料独立实测，不用目录或次级属性系数。
整份供货制剂及制品与非加和含量子账分开；只有有证时才区分留存、游离、液态、蒸气、结构及反应水。电力kWh乘3.6得MJ。真实载热水、凝液或热水返还须记全额质量、相态、温压、焓及供方水能归属；一份供给不得千克和热MJ双购。不假设蒸汽锅炉回路。

calculationRules.rule: 每个物理交换B_e为记录单位状态换算后的原生单位全额真实V_e；负荷交换B_e为专属或因果归属A_e。制造r_e = B_e / Q仅一次；另列放行后服务则B_e / 原Qc。Q与Qc为同一完整配置千克。相关分母为零则保留B_e不出单位结果。卡片及协议目标基准引用此同一结果，不二次相除。
保留原表计称重状态字段。真实速率按记录区间只积分一次，已积分体积不再变化。体积质量桥接用独立实测物质专属密度状态，单位换算用精确原生属性单位支撑。物理核对并归属A_e后才normalize_once，不推密度件重或载热焓。
逐材料保留物理期初+外部接收=期末+外部输出+有证转化；内部交接只抵消一次，反应及元素核对独立。在制及成品按真实队列携带逐交换继承向量。首次放行时Q内部转入成品，即使期末留存也已计生产Q。成品按原Qc追溯原交付冲回返还及真实增量服务，不重建制造。

O + P + I + ER + J_in + H2O_in = C + S + EO + W + J_out + H2O_out。各项均为同一材质或资产池的真实 kg。O/C 为完整湿态期初期末空、附在制、附成品和周转库存。P 为新增外采，I 为互斥供方随货整包装入向，ER 为收到外部返还，S 为随完整毛发运带出，EO 为独立向外返还，W 为整湿废弃物。J_in/J_out 为独立实测且未含于上述整物方向的非水修理、替换、沉积、残留或其他跨池转移。H2O_in/H2O_out 为独立实测且未内含于整物方向的真实水转移，含无修理的自然吸脱湿。真实新增或移除湿材料须按实测拆为互斥 J 和水，不设默认比例或密度。完整 W 已含基材、留存残余及水一次，除非跨界前真实分离，其嵌套子项不另列 J_out/H2O_out。配对内部池转移合并时抵消，不新增采购、服务或 Q。

collectionProtocols.collection_method: O + P + I + ER + J_in + H2O_in = C + S + EO + W + J_out + H2O_out。各项均为同一材质或资产池的真实 kg。O/C 为完整湿态期初期末空、附在制、附成品和周转库存。P 为新增外采，I 为互斥供方随货整包装入向，ER 为收到外部返还，S 为随完整毛发运带出，EO 为独立向外返还，W 为整湿废弃物。J_in/J_out 为独立实测且未含于上述整物方向的非水修理、替换、沉积、残留或其他跨池转移。H2O_in/H2O_out 为独立实测且未内含于整物方向的真实水转移，含无修理的自然吸脱湿。真实新增或移除湿材料须按实测拆为互斥 J 和水，不设默认比例或密度。完整 W 已含基材、留存残余及水一次，除非跨界前真实分离，其嵌套子项不另列 J_out/H2O_out。配对内部池转移合并时抵消，不新增采购、服务或 Q。 原始观测对账为 L_in_observed - X_in = P + I + ER + J_in + H2O_in，以及 L_out_observed - X_out = S + EO + W + J_out + H2O_out。L 仅为观测侧汇总，不是额外实物流或供方需求。每个 X 按精确事件、组分、单位和方向映射到同侧其他重复观测，且规范侧已计一次。每项真实 J/H2O 仍保留一次；X 不因留库存而冲真实留存增量、C/O、对侧移动或嵌套 W 子项。原观测互斥时 X=0。内部附着复用不跨边界，内部维修或资产池转入须有源目的地配对账，不能再计采购和继承负荷。未知料水仍未决，不配残差。真实客户在本工厂或服务门之后的处置是另行披露的下游事件，不虚构为工厂 W。
